themes.name: Coal
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in the IDXIC coal production or coal distribution activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in a dated IDXIC coal activity.
exclusion_rules: Mixed oil, gas and coal equipment activity is excluded from this coal-only theme.

themes.name: Oil & gas
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in a dedicated IDXIC oil and gas activity.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in oil and gas drilling, production, refining, storage or distribution.
exclusion_rules: Coal-only and mixed oil, gas and coal equipment activities are excluded.

themes.name: Gold
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in the IDXIC Gold activity.
exclusion_rules: Diversified miners without the Gold activity classification are excluded.

themes.name: Copper & base metals
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC copper, aluminum, iron and steel, or diversified metals and minerals activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC metals activities.
exclusion_rules: The source classification does not identify nickel or battery-material exposure separately; no issuer is assigned on that basis alone.

themes.name: Alternative energy equipment
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC Alternative Energy Equipment.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in IDXIC Alternative Energy Equipment.
exclusion_rules: This is an equipment classification, not a claim about renewable generation revenue.

themes.name: Electric utilities
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC Electric Utilities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in IDXIC Electric Utilities.
exclusion_rules: Gas utilities are kept outside this electric-utilities theme.

themes.name: Banks
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC Banks.
exclusion_rules: Consumer finance, investment services and financial holdings are excluded.

themes.name: Insurance
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC life, general or reinsurance activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in an IDXIC insurance activity.
exclusion_rules: Banks, brokers and other financial services are excluded.

themes.name: Telecommunications
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC integrated, wired or wireless telecommunication services.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC telecommunication activities.
exclusion_rules: Cable and satellite and networking equipment remain separate IDXIC activities.

themes.name: Logistics & transport
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC logistics, marine ports, road transportation or airlines activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC transport and logistics activities.
exclusion_rules: Airport operators and travel agencies are excluded from this operating-transport theme.

themes.name: Construction & infrastructure
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC civil construction, highways and railtracks, construction materials, or building products activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC construction and infrastructure activities.
exclusion_rules: Conglomerate membership or a project announcement alone does not establish theme membership.

themes.name: Consumer staples
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC food, beverage, personal care or tobacco production activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC consumer-products activities.
exclusion_rules: Plantations and crops are not treated as palm-oil exposure; retail and restaurants remain separate.

themes.name: Retail
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC consumer retail and store activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC retail activities.
exclusion_rules: Consumer distributors, restaurants and e-commerce services are excluded unless classified in a listed retail activity.

themes.name: Healthcare
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC healthcare providers, pharmaceuticals, equipment or supplies distribution activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC healthcare activities.
exclusion_rules: General insurers and non-healthcare consumer goods are excluded.

themes.name: Property
themes.definition: Listed issuers classified in IDXIC real-estate development, management or services activities.
inclusion_rules: Exact membership in one of the listed IDXIC real-estate activities.
exclusion_rules: A named property project or indirect property holding does not establish theme membership.

reviewed_but_not_published.reason: The dated activity label Plantations & Crops does not isolate palm-oil exposure.
The dated activity catalog has no dedicated nickel or battery activity.
Online applications and consumer financing are broader classifications and do not isolate digital finance.
The dated activity catalog has no dedicated data-centre activity.
